name: noul-inverted-signal
description: A custom noul evaluator with signal.invert (the question asks for the good behaviour): noul 0.10 gives risk_raw 1 - 0.10 = 0.90.

question.instructions: Does `assistant_response` name the `evidence` item that supports each of its main statements?

criteria.true: `assistant_response` names a supporting `evidence` item for each main statement
criteria.false: `assistant_response` makes main statements without naming a supporting `evidence` item
